title: RAW UNREVIEWED: the two f83r lower notes share one participant or describe separate stations
summary: GDT790 owns two short embedded prose records under the already admitted f83r lower coupled panel: Q1 .47–49 and Q2 .52–55. First freeze what physical components actually join the two sides; prior work reports only limited visible links and no global circuit. A whole reading of both records can then contrast one participant passed across a joint, with distinct left/right outcomes, against two independently introduced station notes. Demand an independently visible shared endpoint and an overt, consistently interpreted written participant before awarding a cross-record relation. The earlier music-role extension IDEA000521 remains inconclusive and supplies no word meanings.

design.mechanism: two separately owned records either track one physically shared participant through a coupled panel or independently describe different stations
design.unit: the complete f83r lower image panel and both GDT790 embedded records Q1 and Q2
design.contrast: shared-participant handoff with two outcomes versus independent side notes
design.prediction: the handoff reading names an independently visible common endpoint and retains one overt participant across the full Q1/Q2 texts; absent an owned joint or overt bridge means no capacity
